desc: A Backrooms entity shaped like a fox: slim body of black void with torn yellow wallpaper skin, tail made of three bent fluorescent tubes drawn as solid pale bars, hollow eyes, exit-sign green accents on paws and ears, more menacing and ornate than a pet. Pixel art game pet sprite, chibi 2-head-tall, right-facing 3/4 view, full body, clean flat shading with 2-3 tones, small dark eyes with white highlight, no glow, no sparkles, no particles, no ground shadow.
